stage1.impression: A clean, dark CG render of a home-cinema niche: two smoked speakers on lit plinths in a fir-lined alcove, with an empty black carpet in front, blobby tub chairs and a cold white orb in the foreground. The surfaces are smooth and untextured at 1:1 (carpet, chairs, felt panels), the plinths' glowing edges read as LED-strip signage, and the speakers sit too dark to be the hero. As it stands a magazine would see a generic showroom or home theatre, not a specific bar.

blocking_9: Frame lum_median at 22 or more (now 19.0) with the altar speakers' regions at lum_median 45 or more (now 24.2 right, 39.0 left)
Carpet, velvet tub chairs and felt panels need real texture at 1:1 (pile, nap, sheen variation). They are flat CG fills now.
The plinth glow must read as soft light from under the oak, not a clipped white outline (p95 248, clip 0.45% at [760,500,915,575])
The left screen must stop competing with the altar (median 114 against the speaker's 24)
Visible signs of life in the lit foreground (a glass and a record on the table, the coat on a chair). None reads in this frame.
Atmosphere: haze that shows the altar spots' cones and gives the crushed ceiling some depth
A tighter, seated composition so the room feels close and full, not an empty floor with the pair far away

defects.what: Large empty, flat, textureless dark carpet takes about a quarter of the frame and reads as a CG plane
Ceiling and fir beams are almost black (crush 36.9%), so the shell's beams and concrete do not read
Projected screen image is the brightest large area (median 114), cool magenta-white, and pulls the eye off the altar
Orb lamp glows near-white and blue-cool (r165 g176 b190, median 175) against a 2700 K room, like a flat white disc
Plinth light reads as a hard white outline around the top edge, signage-like, clipping
Left plinth has the same white outline glow
Right speaker underexposed (median 24.2). Its acrylic cabinet reads as a dark glass box and the smoked tint has no glow.
Tub chairs are smooth, blobby forms with no velvet nap or seams
Right foreground chairs crushed to near-black silhouettes with no material (median 8.8)
Record sleeve against the plinth reads as a flat beige card with no print or edge
Fir boards are a uniform repeated stripe texture with no checks, nail holes or board-to-board variation
Felt panels behind the speakers are flat brown rectangles with no fabric texture
No haze is visible and the spots throw no cones. The air reads as vacuum.

out_of_scope.request: Give the hero speaker a saturated tint so it carries the frame's one colour
out_of_scope.why: The Smoke configuration and the speakers' colour are fixed. In this configuration the colour must come from light through the smoked acrylic (c1), not from a tint change.

out_of_scope.request: Show a single speaker instead of the pair
out_of_scope.why: The altar's pair is fixed by the room's design.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the visible internal hardware behind the clear cabinet walls
Replace the fir board texture with real, varied boards (checks, nail holes, darker end grain)
out_of_scope.why: This is an asset or texture change to a fixed material. It is allowed only as a finish change, and it is the next step after the eight above if fixing the board repetition is permitted.
